Details.JobSummary: You will serve as Nimitz OIC Technology and Innovation Operations (TIO) Officer for the Technology and Innovation Directorate at the GG-13 grade level tasked with overseeing, coordinating and managing the Directorate tasking involving the Command, the Department, and its multiple subordinate Divisions internal and external.
Details.SubAgencyName: NAVIFOR, Nimitz Operational Intelligence Center, Technology and Innovation Directorate
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will handle sensitive tasking and develop systems/methods to expedite tasking that are sensitive in nature to reach the proper leadership, or Operations Officer in order to meet deadlines.
You will alert management as to Directorate tasking performance gaps.
You will establish and execute processes that enhance efficiency of the Directorate?s daily routine, communications and information flow internally and externally to the Directorate.
You will maintain a physical or virtual Daily Directorate Plan to keep the Directorate and Division Heads informed.
You will conduct analytic reviews and assessments of information, and manages the Department SharePoint site.
You will support the TIO Director in executing and assuming project management and leadership roles to complete - long-term efforts and/or Command directives.
You will support the Director in the oversight and execution of personnel tasking and tracking, including hiring and other administrative efforts.
You will support the Division Heads with security-related issues and concerns.
You will oversee and maintain Fiscal Year travel, training, and supply budget accounting.
You will evaluate information collected and develop analytic tools and methods in order draw specific conclusions.
You will collect, review, interpret, evaluate, and integrate information from multiple sources in order to assess the relevance and significance of developments in the Directorate.
You will engage various echelon II, OIC echelon III commands externally and other Operations Officers, Department Managers, and supervisors within the Naval Intelligence Enterprise.
You will synchronize responses and seek customer's direction on all Requests for Information (RFIs), as well as tasks entered via COLISEUM and the Task Management System (TMS).
You will work closely with the Center and Operations Officers to ensure Requests for Information (RFIs) crossing various commands' missions/functions/tasks (MFT) boundaries are fully addressed.
You will prepare new or revise prior Directorate products, such as briefings, databases, studies, plans.
You will maintain liaison with personnel in other Agencies, Centers, Officers, and the Operational Forces as required in order to discuss requirements and provide information services.
You will act as the Directorate representative at interagency and internal meetings and conferences in order to present and defend Directorate positions or controversial issues.
You may serve as the chairperson or member of a working group or committee in his or her areas of responsibility.

Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: With a workforce of more than 13,000 reflecting our nation's diverse cultures and backgrounds, and annual sales of more than $4.5M, the Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) operates a worldwide chain of 236 commissaries providing groceries to active-duty military families, retirees and their families, DeCA employees, and other authorized patrons in a safe and secure shopping environment. A core military family support element and a valued part of military pay and benefits, commissaries contribute to family readiness, enhance the quality of life for America's military and their families, and help recruit and retain the best and brightest men and women to serve our country.
MajorDuties: Serves as the Computer Assited Ordering Technician in a Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) location. The primary purpose of this position is to maintain accurate perpetual inventory balance on hand (BOH) levels which in turn determines optimum ordering quantities and ensures product availability for patrons. Position responsibilities include: Maintains the Computer Assisted Ordering (CAO) system with current, accurate data to ensure optimal order quantities are calculated necessary to sustain customer demands. Uses radio-frequency hand-held terminals to gather data necessary to update and adjust inventory. Records and updates Balance on Hand (BOH) data; maintains perpetual inventory and audits credits. Performs daily inventory audit of items not-in-stock and overwrite items. Evaluates stock levels of all CAO categories daily by physically reviewing the storage and display shelf locations, shippers and warehouse. Interfaces with all levels of management and deals directly with commercial distributor/vendor stocking representatives on issues affecting CAO.

Future military retirees must include a copy of their terminal leave request, if applicable, AND (1) a copy of their retirement DD214 [Member 4 copy] OR (2) a certification document* OR (3) a copy of their retirement letter. Future military separatees must include a copy of their terminal leave request, if applicable, AND (1) a copy of their most recent DD214 [Member 4 copy] OR (2) a certification document* OR (3) a copy of their most recent active duty orders. *A written document from the armed forces certifying the service member is expected to be discharged or released from active duty service in the armed forces under honorable conditions not later than 120 days after the date the certificate is signed. The certification must be on letterhead signed by the adjutant, personnel officer, unit commander or higher headquarters and include your rank, dates of active duty service, type of discharge, character of service, and, if applicable, the date your terminal leave begins. This document is sometimes called a Statement of Service. Notes for those claiming veterans' preference:
1. Active duty military members who are selected may not be appointed to a position unless on terminal leave or already separated.
2. You are required to provide your final DD214 upon issuance, if it was not part of your application package.
3. Within the DoD, appointment of retired military members to a civilian position within 180 days immediately after retirement is subject to the provisions of 5 U.S.C. 3326. Claiming Military Spouse Preference. You must be the spouse of an active duty member of the armed forces, and your application package must include the Military Spouse PPP Self-Certification Checklist AND proof of marriage to the military service member (e.g., marriage certificate, marriage license), AND a copy of the military member's PCS orders. Claiming ICTAP eligibility. Your application package must include a copy of your agency-specific ICTAP eligibility notice or a copy of your separation personnel action form AND a copy of your most recent performance appraisal AND a copy of your most recent SF 50 or agency notification of personnel action showing your current position, grade level, and duty location. Separation personnel actions do not include a certificate/notice of expected separation.
Details.OtherInformation: Applicants with a Permanent Resident Card (aka Green Card) are authorized to live and work in the U.S. but are not eligible for employment in positions requiring U.S. citizenship. This position requires U.S. citizenship. The minimum age requirement is generally 18 years of age. Employing those under 18 may be possible under certain circumstances. If under 18 years of age, ensure you provide documentation showing how you are eligible. Position does not meet the DoD criteria for re-employing former Federal employees who retired under either the Civil Service Retirement System (CSRS) or the Federal Employees Retirement System (FERS). Work environment: You may work in hot or cold weather and/or in damp or drafty conditions, be exposed to differences in temperature in storing or obtaining items from refrigerated rooms or in the warehouse, and while working you may receive minor injuries such as cuts, scrapes, bruises, heat sealer burns, and may slip on wet floors. Position is not obligated. Position is nonexempt from Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). Position may be subject to occasional overtime. Bargaining unit status varies by location. Financial Difficulty does not automatically remove you from consideration for a position. Selections are subject to restrictions resulting from the DoD referral system for displaced employees. We encourage you to review the Safer Federal Workplace information regarding COVID-19. Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Details.JobSummary: This position is part of the Warfare Centers Personnel Demonstration Project. The NT-6 pay band encompasses positions equivalent to GS-14 and GS-15. You will serve as the Deputy Business Director (DBD) of the Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division Newport.
Details.SubAgencyName: Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division Newport
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will align NUWC Division Newport's business operations with the Command's strategic plan, mission, vision, along with the Command Officers/Technical Directors goals and objectives.

You will closely collaborate with the Technical Director, Commanding Officer, Deputy Technical Director for Technical Excellence, Department Heads, and with stakeholders and subject matter experts within and outside NUWC Division Newport.
You will work across NUWC Division Newport leadership with a focus on both business process efficiencies and stewardship of our technical domains.
You will conduct Command workload planning and assessment, budgeting, and lead strategic planning initiatives.
You will coordinate with the Comptroller to establish Department financial targets (reimbursable, direct cite, and overhead) along with resolutions to any under/over execution issues.
You will assess the current health of all business and human capital elements of the organization and forecast and establish plans to meet future business performance goals.
You will lead the preservation of our Technical Capability responsibilities, Technical Capability Health Assessments, and Facility Capability Health Assessments.
You will identify and implement tools and systems to capture the proper Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) to allow for fact-based decision making in all business operations decisions.

You will lead internal and external teams, evaluate stakeholder inputs, promote business transparency, and develop plans and options to drive the Division's business strategies to optimize utilization of NUWC Division Newport resources.
You will identify and leverage a wide variety of business data to optimize business operations execution, and develop and implement metrics, tracking tools and health assessments.
You will assess the impact of compliance and identify options to optimize business process efficiency.
Details.Evaluations: In order to qualify for this position, your resume must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the specific position for which you are being considered. Therefore, we encourage you to be clear and specific when describing your experience. When the application process is complete, we will review your resume to ensure you meet the hiring eligibility and qualification requirements listed in this announcement. You will be rated based on the information provided in your resume and responses to the Occupational Questionnaire, along with your supporting documentation to determine your ability to demonstrate the following competencies: BUSINESS OPERATIONSLEADING HIGH-PERFORMANCE TEAMSMANAGING HUMAN RESOURCESPROBLEM SOLVINGRESOURCE MANAGEMENTSTRATEGIC THINKING You should list any relevant performance appraisals and incentive awards in your resume as that information may be taken into consideration during the selection process. If selected, you may be required to provide supporting documentation. If after reviewing your resume and supporting documentation, a determination is made that you inflated your qualifications and/or experience, your score may be adjusted to more accurately reflect your abilities or you may be found ineligible/not qualified. Please follow all instructions carefully. Errors or omissions may affect your rating or consideration for employment. All eligibility and qualification requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

You will serve as a Management & Program Analyst in the Engineering Branch of the Undersea Weapons Program Office (PMS 404), in the Weapons Systems Engineering Branch (Code 8521) of the Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division Newport.

MajorDuties: You will provide planning, analysis, and evaluation for the efficiency and execution of torpedo development programs within the Engineering Branch of PMS404.
You will provide program office leadership with objectivity based information for making decisions.

You will analyze and evaluate, on a quantitative or qualitative basis, the effectiveness across various activities (e.g. contractors, warfare centers, UARCs) in meeting established program milestones, goals, and objectives.
You will develop life cycle cost analyses of projects or perform cost benefit evaluations of programs.

You will advise on the workload distribution of various organizations and the ability of those organizations to execute planned tasking within
each fiscal year.
You will develop new or modified program plans, strategies, metrics, goals, or objectives.
You will identify and develop data required for use in the management and direction of programs.
You will develop program evaluation plans and report these to program office leadership.
You will identify resources (staff, funding, equipment, of facilities) required to support program execution.
You will provide programmatic recommendations related to cost, schedule, and risks.
You will lead the creation and/or maintenance of program acquisition documents.
You will participate in and attend program meetings and reviews as a program office representative.
You will analyze and evaluate proposed changes in program execution and provide recommendations to program office leadership.

You will perform duties as a Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) as appointed and in accordance with NAVSEA's Contracting Officer's
Representative Instruction approximately 25% of the time.

Details.JobSummary: You will serve as the Department Contracts Manager (DCM) in the BUSINESS OPERATIONS OFFICE in the RANGES, ENGINEERING AND ANALYSIS DEPT for NAVUNSEAWARCENDIV NEWPORT RI. The NT-4 pay band encompasses positions equivalent to GS-11 and GS-12. The NT-5 pay band encompasses positions equivalent to GS-13 and GS-14. This is not a high grade position; therefore, the salary may be limited to a GS-13 Step 10 (currently $137,348).
Details.SubAgencyName: Naval Undersea Warfare Center Newport Division
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will analyze technical performance of Department products to ensure proper contract vehicle.

You will develop modifications and improvements to existing processes (as required) in the areas of procurement, contract administration, and
knowledge management and configuration management efforts.
You will sever as lead and primary interface with communication between Department and Code 02
You will manage and track all contractual actions and reporting the status of pre and post award department acquisitions

You will communicate orally and in writing supporting program managers in developing and articulating contractual requirements and measures
of performance
you will research new policies, directives, manuals, operating procedures and guidance related to DOD acquisitions
You will develop department acquisition policies, instructions and processes
You will develop templates for abstracts, and all correspondence required from the CORs/PIs/TPMs via the department
You will support one-on-ones, metrics, contract assessment, cross department acquisitions

You will develop key metrics / criteria to monitor and assess effectiveness of the new and/or modified processes / operations implemented
into the division.
Details.Education:
In lieu of specialized experience, you may qualify with the following education or combination of both education and experience: For the NT-04: A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree.
OR
Three full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D. or equivalent degree.
OR
A LL.M. degree that is related to the position being filled. https://www.usajobs.gov/Help/working-in-government/unique-hiringpaths/students/federal-occupations-by-college-major/
OR
A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience. My percentage of the required education plus my percentage of the required experience equal one hundred percent. A transcript must be submitted with your application if qualifying using education. See Required Documents for additional information.
Details.Evaluations: In order to qualify for this position, your resume must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the specific position for which you are being considered. Your resume is the key means we have for evaluating your skills, knowledge, and abilities as they relate to this position. Therefore, we encourage you to be clear and specific when describing your experience. When the application process is complete, we will review your resume to ensure you meet the hiring eligibility and qualification requirements listed in this announcement. You will be rated based on the information provided in your resume and responses to the Occupational Questionnaire, along with your supporting documentation to determine your ability to demonstrate the following competencies: BUSINESS OPERATIONSCONTRACTING/PROCUREMENTDEVELOPING OTHERSPROBLEM SOLVING You should list any relevant performance appraisals and incentive awards in your resume as that information may be taken into consideration during the selection process. All eligibility and qualifications requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Details.HowToApply:

Note: To check the status of your application or return to a previous or incomplete application, log into your USAJOBS account: https://mydon.usajobs.gov/Account/Login select Application Status, and click on the more information link under the application status for this position. Applying online will allow you to review and track the status of your application. Do not email or send hard copy resumes/applications to the Contact Information or Agency Information listed in this vacancy announcement. Details.WhatToExpectNext: When the application process is complete, your complete application (resume, assessment questionnaire, and all supporting documents) will be reviewed to determine if you meet the hiring eligibility and qualification requirements for which you requested consideration. You will be rated based on the information provided in your resume and responses to the questionnaire, along with your supporting documentation to determine your level of knowledge, skill, and ability related to the job requirements. Generally, only best qualified candidates will be referred to the hiring manager. Sometimes well qualified and minimally qualified candidates are referred. Occasionally, candidates eligible for priority consideration are referred, and no other candidates are referred. The hiring manager may choose to conduct interviews. NOTE: Due to COVID19, if you have any questions or need assistance, please email the DON Employment Information Center at DONEIC@us.navy.mil
Details.RequiredDocuments:
You are required to provide documentation that supports the eligibility and qualification claims made in your resume and assessment questionnaire. You must submit the applicable documents listed here and those listed with the eligibilities you select in the announcement questionnaire with your application package. Applicants who do not provide supporting documentation that fully support their claims will not be referred to the hiring manager. Cover letter is optional. A complete resume is required. Your resume must show relevant experience, job title, duties and accomplishments. Your resume must show complete information for each job entry to support minimum qualifications. The following information should be provided in your resume, but it is acceptable to provide elsewhere in your application package: employer's name, starting and end dates (Mo/Yr), hours per week, and pay plan, series and grade level (e.g. GS-0201-09) for relevant federal experience.TIP: A good way to ensure you include all essential information is to use the Resume Builder in USAJOBS to create your resume. SF-50s that have an effective date within the past year (e.g., General Adjustment SF-50 from this year or Within Rate/Grade Increases (WRI/WGI) SF-50 within a year) do not clearly show that you meet the one-year time-in-grade requirement. That means if you submit an SF-50 that is dated within the last year, you must submit another SF-50 that is dated more than one year ago to clearly demonstrate you meet the time-in-grade requirements. If you are a DoD employee, you can obtain a copy of your SF- 50(s) from MyBiz. Are you claiming membership in any professional organizations, or possession of a license, certificate or credentials? Check the Conditions of Employment section above to see if any are required. If you claim membership, license, certification, or credentials, you must submit a copy of said document in your application package. Are you using education as a substitute for some or all of the experience requirement? Is there a basic education requirement for this position? Check the Education section above to see what is allowed and what is required. Any claims you make in your resume or assessment questionnaire regarding education or degrees MUST be supported by submitting with your application official or unofficial transcripts or a list of courses, grades earned, completion dates, and quarter and semester hours earned issued from your school. While unofficial transcripts are acceptable for initial application, an official transcript will ultimately be required if you are selected for the position. You may submit a copy your degree(s) if specific coursework does not have to be verified. Are you a veteran claiming 5-point veterans' preference or claiming sole survivorship preference? You must submit a copy of your latest DD-214 Certificate of Release or Discharge from Active Duty (any copy that shows all dates of service, as well as character of service [Honorable, General, etc.] is acceptable) OR a VA letter that shows dates of service or service connected disability AND character of service. If you have more than one DD-214 for multiple periods of active duty service, submit a copy for each period of service. If you were issued a DD-215 to amend aforementioned information on the DD-214 you must submit that too. If you are not sure of your preference eligibility, visit the Department of Labor's website: Veterans' Preference Advisor Are you a disabled veteran or claiming 10-point veterans' preference?
If you are eligible to claim 10 point veterans preference you must submit a DD-214 Certificate of Release or Discharge from Active Duty as described above for 5-point preference. You must also provide the applicable supporting documentation of your disability (e.g. disability letter from the VA) as described on Standard Form-15 (SF-15). http://www.opm.gov/forms/pdf_fill/SF15.pdf. Are you an active duty service member? Active Duty Service Members are required to submit a statement of service printed on command letterhead and signed by the command. The statement of service must provide the branch of service, rate/rank, all dates of service, the expected date of discharge and anticipated character of service (Honorable, General, etc.). Documents submitted as part of the application package, to include supplemental documents, may be shared beyond the Human Resources Office. Some supplemental documents contain personal information such as SSN and DOB and some documents such as military orders and marriage certificates may contain personal information for someone other than you. You may sanitize these documents to remove said personal information before you submit your application. You must provide an un-sanitized version of the documents if you are selected.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary:
In addition to the Basic Requirements for this position, your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the (GS-12) grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Expert experience applying knowledge in MSC roles and responsibility IRT ADCON, OPCON and TYCOM or similar; Experience in operational planning, organizational design and execution of operational tactics in the disciplines of Information Warfare (IW), and Information related capabilities; Experience in Strategic Planning Procedures and implement policy and actions to address overall development and sustainment mission and objectives; Experience in the concepts and practices of counter-intelligence, surveillance and the operational and tactical levels of war. Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website:
https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=Group-Standards Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Details.JobSummary:
You will serve as a INFORMATION WARFARE OFFICER in the Information Warfare Integration Branch (N2IW) of the Operations
Directorate (N2/3) of MILITARY SEALIFT COMMAND.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will serve as an Intelligence subject matter expert for the provision of agile operational control of assigned fleet forces in all operating environments and the collection, application, and manipulation of valuable information WRT.

You will develop in-depth intelligence analytical assessments based on a comprehensive knowledge
of human intelligence (HUMINT) and signal intelligence (SIGINT).
You will provide expert advice on intelligence and information warfare products that will enable the Commander to make informed decisions.

You will participate in strategic planning processes by analyzing national, Navy, Joint, and command strategic
documents, plans, operations, and intelligence products to develop IW strategic guidance.
You will identify and develop ways to resolve difficult problems or cope with issues that affect the accomplishment of goals and objectives.
You will conduct fact-finding analysis of issues at hand to identify and clarify problems or relevant issues.
You will develop, implement, and s IW training courses; civilian mariner training on IW tactics.
You will plan work flow and assignments, and reviews and approve final work products and plans; sets and adjusts long-term priorities.
Details.Education: Applicants must meet the following positive education qualifications requirements of the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualifications Standards Manual: Applicants must possess Basic Requirements: Degree: physical science, engineering, or mathematics that included 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science such as mechanics, dynamics, properties of materials, and electronics. or Combination of education and experience -- education equivalent to one of the majors shown in A above that included at least 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

Details.JobSummary: You will serve as a Lead Program Analyst (Business Services) in the Military Sealift Command (MSC), Directorate Ship Management (DSM), and Directorate Ship Management Business Support Group (DSMB) of MILITARY SEALIFT COMMAND.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will work with Program Managers and other DSM personnel to support with processing purchase requests from initial request to finalization and receipt of product or service.

You will ensure that contractors provide required reports and data (fuel consumption, force protection status, etc.) to the required MSC office in support of command management initiatives and metrics development.

You will serve as senior analyst and lead over a team of Program Analysts involved in planning, coordinating,
recommending and executing a variety of courses of action for administrative requirements.
You will formulate budgets and estimates to support plans, programs, and activities, including presenting and defending budget obligations and expenditures.
You will analyze and recommend costs and benefits of alternative methods of organization's programs and administrative operations.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: analyzing information to identify problems related to financial/administrative support functions for a program, working with management for process improvements, and providing the full range of administrative functions. Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Details.JobSummary: There are two open positions: You will serve as an Administrative/Technical Specialist in the Machinery Research, Logistics & Ship Integrity Department (Code 30) or the Cybersecure HM&E Control Systems & Networks Department (Code 50) of Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division (NSWC PHILA DIV) serving as the Department Management Assistant..
Details.SubAgencyName: Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will provide the full range of administrative and financial management functions to support the accomplishment of the Department's assigned mission.
You will administer budget and provide analysis and planning services.
You will identify financial management problems and trends and resolve issues.
You will work with external administrative specialists, professionals, customers and counterparts to resolve issues.
You will employ policies, precedents, goals, objectives and guidelines of financial oversight and operations.
You will identify and analyze trends that are related to budget and finance.
You will create and maintain department databases.
You will coordinate internal and external awards.
You will process travel arrangements.
You will track training requirements and completion.
Details.Education:

***** Education may be substituted for specialized experience as follows: A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree; OR Three full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree; OR An LL.M., if related to the position being filled; OR A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience. For the NT 03:
***** Education may be substituted for specialized experience as follows: A master's or equivalent graduate degree; OR Two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's or equivalent graduate degree; OR An LL.B. or J.D., if related to the position being filled; OR A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience.

I have one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level (GS-07) or pay band in the federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Experience in customer service, Knowledge of standardized administrative practices and procedures, and Skill in written and oral communication sufficient to prepare and present findings and recommendations; Experience analyzing and advising on proposed reorganizations or realignment functions. MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: This is a public notice flyer to notify interested applicants of anticipated vacancies. Applications will not be accepted through this flyer. Interested applicants must follow the directions in the "How to Apply" section of this flyer to be considered. There may or may not be actual vacancies filled from this flyer. Notice of Result letters will not be sent to applicants who respond to this flyer. The Deputy Associated Director of Research (ADOR) for Business Operations assists the ADOR in directing and planning the various business functions of the NRL Business Operations Directorate. As full deputy, the Deputy ADOR acts at all times with the authority of the ADOR in assigned areas, and exercises all powers in the absence of the ADOR. The Deputy ADOR is responsible for participating in the conception, planning, formulation and execution of the Business Operations Directorate's various financial, business systems, logistics, facilities and related business and services functions. In the absence of the ADOR, the Deputy assumes full line management responsibilities for the entire Directorate. The Business Operations Directorate is comprised of four major divisions: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Business Systems Division, Financial Management Division, Supply and Administrative Services Division, and the Research and Development Services Division. This position has a Selective Placement Factor (SPF). Applicants must meet the SPF or be considered ineligible for the position. The SPF is: extensive knowledge of and the ability to utilize principles, methods, techniques, and systems of financial management of the Department of the Defense, and knowledge of contracting, facilities, business systems, and logistics operations. Your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the NO-04 (GS-13) grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent specialized experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following experience in business areas include acquisition, finance, facilities and business information systems: 1) oversee business operations to ensure program is on-track, milestones are met and ensure these operations serve organizational objectives; 2) serve as an advisor to senior leaders and recommend actions to fulfill business objectives; and, 3) provide guidance on business policies to ensure they serve organizational objectives, specifically in a scientific and/or technical arena. Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website under the Administrative and Management category: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=Group-Standards Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

1. Complete resume with relevant experience, job title, duties and accomplishments. Your resume must show complete information for each job entry to support minimum qualifications. The following information should be provided in your resume, but it is acceptable to provide elsewhere in your application package: employer's name, starting and end dates (Mo/Yr), hours per week, and pay plan, series and grade level (e.g. GS-0201-09) for relevant federal experience.TIP: A good way to ensure you include all essential information is to use the Resume Builder in USAJOBS to create your resume.
2. Complete assessment questionnaire. For a quick preview of the assessment questionnaire click here: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/11677862
3. Supporting documentation Failure to submit a complete application package will result in an ineligible rating and loss of consideration. Your complete application (resume, assessment questionnaire, and all supporting documents) must be received by 11:59 pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 10/12/2022. Applications received after 10/12/2022 will generally result in an ineligible rating and loss of consideration. If more than one resume is received, only the last resume received and processed will be reviewed. Note: To check the status of your application or return to a previous or incomplete application, log into your USAJOBS account: https://mydon.usajobs.gov/Account/Login select Application Status, and click on the more information link under the application status for this position. Your uploaded documents may take several hours to clear the virus scan process so please plan appropriately. You are encouraged to apply online. Applying online will allow you to review and track the status of your application. Do not email or send hard copy resumes/applications to the Contact Information or Agency Information listed in this vacancy announcement. All resumes/applications received at the addresses listed in the Contact Information or Agency Information will be destroyed and will not be considered for this vacancy announcement. It is the applicant's responsibility to verify that all information in their resume and documents are legible and accurate. HR will not modify answers/documents submitted by an applicant.
Details.WhatToExpectNext: When the application process is complete, your complete application (resume, assessment questionnaire, and all supporting documents) will be reviewed to determine if you meet the hiring eligibility and qualification requirements for which you requested consideration. You will be rated based on the information provided in your resume and responses to the questionnaire, along with your supporting documentation to determine your level of knowledge, skill, and ability related to the job requirements. Generally, only best qualified candidates will be referred to the hiring manager. Sometimes well qualified and minimally qualified candidates are referred. Occasionally, candidates eligible for priority consideration are referred, and no other candidates are referred. The hiring manager may choose to conduct interviews. You will be notified of our rating and referral decision. If you are referred, you will be notified when a hiring decision is made. NOTE: Due to COVID19, if you have any questions or need assistance, please email the DON Employment Information Center at DONEIC@us.navy.mil
Details.RequiredDocuments:
You are required to provide documentation that supports the eligibility and qualification claims made in your resume and assessment questionnaire. You must submit the applicable documents listed here and those listed with the eligibilities you select in the announcement questionnaire with your application package. Applicants who do not provide supporting documentation that fully support their claims will not be referred to the hiring manager. Cover letter is optional. A complete resume is required. Your resume must show relevant experience, job title, duties and accomplishments. Your resume must show complete information for each job entry to support minimum qualifications. The following information should be provided in your resume, but it is acceptable to provide elsewhere in your application package: employer's name, starting and end dates (Mo/Yr), hours per week, and pay plan, series and grade level (e.g. GS-0201-09) for relevant federal experience.TIP: A good way to ensure you include all essential information is to use the Resume Builder in USAJOBS to create your resume. Are you applying for a promotion? To be considered for a promotion, you must provide SF-50(s) that shows that you have held the next lower GS grade for at least one year. SF-50s that have an effective date within the past year (e.g., General Adjustment SF-50 from this year or Within Rate/Grade Increases (WRI/WGI) SF-50 within a year) do not clearly show that you meet the one-year time-in-grade requirement. That means if you submit an SF-50 that is dated within the last year, you must submit another SF-50 that is dated more than one year ago to clearly demonstrate you meet the time-in-grade requirements. If you are a DoD employee, you can obtain a copy of your SF- 50(s) from MyBiz. Are you claiming membership in any professional organizations, or possession of a license, certificate or credentials? Check the Conditions of Employment section above to see if any are required. If you claim membership, license, certification, or credentials, you must submit a copy of said document in your application package. Are you using education as a substitute for some or all of the experience requirement? Is there a basic education requirement for this position? Check the Education section above to see what is allowed and what is required. Any claims you make in your resume or assessment questionnaire regarding education or degrees MUST be supported by submitting with your application official or unofficial transcripts or a list of courses, grades earned, completion dates, and quarter and semester hours earned issued from your school. While unofficial transcripts are acceptable for initial application, an official transcript will ultimately be required if you are selected for the position. You may submit a copy your degree(s) if specific coursework does not have to be verified. Are you a veteran claiming 5-point veterans' preference or claiming sole survivorship preference? You must submit a copy of your latest DD-214 Certificate of Release or Discharge from Active Duty (any copy that shows all dates of service, as well as character of service [Honorable, General, etc.] is acceptable) OR a VA letter that shows dates of service or service connected disability AND character of service. If you have more than one DD-214 for multiple periods of active duty service, submit a copy for each period of service. If you were issued a DD-215 to amend aforementioned information on the DD-214 you must submit that too. If you are not sure of your preference eligibility, visit the Department of Labor's website: Veterans' Preference Advisor Are you a disabled veteran or claiming 10-point veterans' preference?
If you are eligible to claim 10 point veterans preference you must submit a DD-214 Certificate of Release or Discharge from Active Duty as described above for 5-point preference. You must also provide the applicable supporting documentation of your disability (e.g. disability letter from the VA) as described on Standard Form-15 (SF-15). http://www.opm.gov/forms/pdf_fill/SF15.pdf. Are you an active duty service member? Active Duty Service Members are required to submit a statement of service printed on command letterhead and signed by the command. The statement of service must provide the branch of service, rate/rank, all dates of service, the expected date of discharge and anticipated character of service (Honorable, General, etc.). Documents submitted as part of the application package, to include supplemental documents, may be shared beyond the Human Resources Office. Some supplemental documents contain personal information such as SSN and DOB and some documents such as military orders and marriage certificates may contain personal information for someone other than you. You may sanitize these documents to remove said personal information before you submit your application. You must provide an un-sanitized version of the documents if you are selected.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: I have at least one year of specialized Management & Program Analyst experience equivalent to the GS-11 grade level in the Federal Service or equivalent pay band or equivalent experience in the private sector that demonstrates a strong knowledge and skill in applying analytical and evaluative techniques to studies concerning the efficiency and effectiveness of knowledge management initiatives, program operations, program goals, and work processes of the organization for areas such as human resource and manpower utilization (financial management). Experience also includes performing management and program planning, scheduling, and resource analysis in order to evaluate and recommend ways to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of work operations in a program setting. Examples of specialized experience includes: 1) Planning, scheduling and conducting multiple projects and studies to evaluate and recommend ways to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of work operations and programs; 2) Developing, analyzing, evaluating, advising and improving the effectiveness of work methods and procedures, organization, knowledge management initiatives, management controls, information and documentation systems, and some areas of financial and administrative management; 3) Interviewing and researching various sources/contacts for fact-finding and evaluating work processes, administrative procedures, workload distribution, organizational structures, management processes, etc; 4) Assist Executive Staff in matters pertaining to financial management, human resources, and administrative management. Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Details.JobSummary: You will serve as Management and Program Analyst in the Contracting Department of NAVSUP FLC NORVA GF.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will plan, schedule, and conduct multiple projects and studies to evaluate and recommend ways to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of work operations and programs..

You will interview and research various sources/contacts for fact-finding and evaluating work processes, administrative procedures, workload distribution, organizational structures, and management processes.
You will work with the Group Leader in implementing Knowledge Management initiatives throughout the activity.

You will perform statistical analysis of projects, processes, services, etc., and develop graphs, prepare briefs, write reports, make presentations with study results and recommendations to management.

Develop studies and engage in computation of staffing standards and comparative analyses which reflect the relationship of manpower requirements to approved program changes and operating target allotments.

Your resume is the key means we have for evaluating your skills, knowledge, and abilities as they relate to this position. Therefore, we encourage you to be clear and specific when describing your experience. When the application process is complete, we will review your resume to ensure you meet the hiring eligibility and qualification requirements listed in this announcement. You will be rated based on the information provided in your resume and responses to the Occupational Questionnaire, along with your supporting documentation to determine your ability to demonstrate the following competencies: ANALYTICAL TECHNIQUESORAL COMMUNICATIONPARTNERINGPROCESS IMPROVEMENTREPORTING AND RECOMMENDATIONS You should list any relevant performance appraisals and incentive awards in your resume as that information may be taken into consideration during the selection process. If selected, you may be required to provide supporting documentation. If after reviewing your resume and supporting documentation, a determination is made that you inflated your qualifications and/or experience, your score may be adjusted to more accurately reflect your abilities or you may be found ineligible/not qualified. Please follow all instructions carefully. Errors or omissions may affect your rating or consideration for employment. All eligibility, qualifications, and time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: For GS-12: Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-11 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Assisting in accomplishment of business objectives (e.g., analysis of subjects, phases, or issues, assessment of unusual circumstances, variations in approach of incomplete or conflicting data, security policies) for life cycle management of information resources (e.g., access, data integrity) within an organization. For GS-11: Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-09 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Monitoring and reporting recurring technical problems to maintain efficiency of program operations. Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Details.JobSummary: You will serve as an Assistant Contract Technical Representative (ACTR) in the Cyber Information Technology (IT) and Systems Operations Department (Code 66) of Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) Logistics Center (NSLC), Keyport Division, Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC) Mechanicsburg, PA (NAVSEALOGCENKYPTDIVNUWC MECH PA).
Details.SubAgencyName: NAVSEA Logistics Center, Keyport Division, Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC) Mechanicsburg, PA
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite! The Naval Sea Logistics Center (NSLC) is a multi-site echelon five activity aligned with the Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division Keyport (NUWCDIVKPT). The Command's mission is to serve as the Naval Sea System Command's (NAVSEA) Technical Agent for developing, maintaining, and assessing life-cycle logistics support policies, procedures, products, and data systems. In doing so, it provides the logistics foundation required to implement cost effective life-cycle logistics and maintenance support and solutions for NAVSEA's Acquisition and Sustainment Program Offices, Warfare Centers, and Fleet units.
MajorDuties: You will utilize information tools and assets to accomplish business objectives for Information Technologies (IT) and Department of Defense (DoD) contracting and security policies.
You will order new Navy/Marine Corps Intranet (NMCI) services, resolve day-to-day NMCI operational issues, and communicate NMCI guidance from the contract technical representative (CTR).
You will prepare presentations concerning aspects of assignments for project stakeholders and higher level officials.
You will apply analytical and evaluative methods to studies concerning the efficiency and effectiveness of program operations carried out by administrative personnel.
You will interpret and apply DoD, Department of the Navy (DON), NMCI directives/instructions relating to Information Technology/Information Management.
You will interface, control and/or coordinate establishment and oversight of NMCI seat management contracts.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: To qualify for a Management Services Specialist, your qualifications must include: A. Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position and is directly in or related to this position. To qualify at the GS-09 level, applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-07 level or equivalent under other pay systems in the Federal service, military or private sector. Applicants must meet eligibility requirements including time-in-grade (General Schedule (GS) positions only), time-after-competitive appointment, minimum qualifications, and any other regulatory requirements by the cut-off/closing date of the announcement. Creditable specialized experience includes: Participates in administrative studies and analyzes workload data to determine the effectiveness of various administrative operations; Supports the coordination and review of procedures for various personnel programs; Provides support and makes recommendations to managers regarding various programs including the drug test program, light duty program, awards program, time and attendance and internal hiring procedures. B. Education Substitution: Such education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work. Education must be from a college or university accredited by an organization approved by the U.S. Department of Education. See http://ope.ed.gov/accreditation/Search.aspx. If using education to meet basic qualifications, YOU MUST SUBMIT A TRANSCRIPT as supplemental documentation. To qualify based on education in lieu of specialized experience, applicants must possess: a Master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.B. or J.D., if related. C. Combination: Combinations of successfully completed post-high school education and experience may be used to meet total qualification requirements for grade levels GS-09 and may be computed by first determining the applicant's total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the applicant's education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages. The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify an applicant for that grade level. Only graduate education in excess of the amount required for the next lower grade level may be used to qualify applicants for positions at grade levels GS-09. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: America's Combat Logistics Support Agency: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) agency. DLA provides worldwide logistics support for the missions of the Military Departments and the Unified Combatant Commands under conditions of peace and war. It also provides logistics support to other DoD Components and certain Federal agencies, foreign governments, international organizations, and others as authorized. By joining Defense Logistics Agency Distribution, you will be a part of the team that is the leading provider of global distribution support to America's military. Whether you work at the DLA Distribution Headquarters in New Cumberland, Pa. or at one of our 24 distribution centers around the globe, your work will ensure that DLA Distribution offers the right solution, on time, every time through a broad range of services to include storage, distribution, customized kits, specialized packaging and world-wide transportation support. DLA Distribution makes a difference every day by providing effective, efficient and best value support to our customers which include the United States Army, Marine Corps, Navy and Air Force as well as other government agencies.
MajorDuties: Serves as an administrative specialist by providing a wide variety of technical advice and assistance for administrative, personnel, and management-related functions within the organization.
Works closely with managers throughout the organization in formulating policies and making decisions on matters impacting administrative functions.
Participates in the development and implementation of standardized policies, practices and procedures throughout the organization.

Implements depot level award policy and procedures; reviews justifications of submitted award requests and advises managers on appropriateness of award types and monetary amounts, ensuring consistency across the depot.

Advises supervisors and coordinates with the servicing Human Resources Office on various performance management, labor/employee relations, position classification, staffing, recruitment, employee development, and drug testing issues.
Details.Education: Are you using your education to qualify? You MUST provide transcripts or other documentation to support your educational claims. Unless otherwise stated: Unofficial transcripts are acceptable at time of application. GRADUATE EDUCATION: One academic year of graduate education is considered to be the number of credits hours that your graduate school has determined to represent one academic year of full-time study. Such study may have been performed on a full-time or part-time basis. If you cannot obtain your graduate school's definition of one year of graduate study, 18 semester hours (or 27 quarter hours) should be considered as satisfying the requirement for one year of full-time graduate study. FOREIGN EDUCATION: If you are using education completed in foreign colleges or universities to meet the qualification requirements, you must show that the education credentials have been evaluated by a private organization that specializes in interpretation of foreign education programs and such education has been deemed equivalent to that gained in an accredited U.S. education program; or full credit has been given for the courses at a U.S. accredited college or university.

DRUG-FREE WORKPLACE: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) has established a Drug-Free Federal Workplace Policy. All applicants tentatively selected for DLA employment in a testing designated position are subject to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Applicants who refuse to be tested will be denied employment with DLA for a period of six months. This policy extends to random testing for the use of illegal drugs by employees who occupy testing designated positions defined as sensitive in Section 7(d) of Executive Order 12564. The Defense Logistics Agency's Drug Free Workplace Plan's drug testing panel includes testing for the following illegal substances: marijuana, cocaine, opiates (codeine/morphine), 6-Acetylmorphine (heroin), phencyclidine, amphetamines (amphetamine/methamphetamine), methylenedioxymethamphetamine (MDMA), methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA), oxycodone, oxymorphone, hydrocodone, and hydromorphone. MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-11 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1) Ensuring an organization follows established policies, codes, regulations, and requirements for the planning, programming, budgeting, and execution of Public Private Venture (PPV) projects; 2) Build and maintain working relationships with other professionals through effective communication to solve PPV issues and challenges involving real estate, community planning, land development, architecture, facilities engineering, construction management, and housing management; 3) Interpreting and making recommendations for enforcement and amendments to portions of PPV Business Agreements; and 4) Developing and executing Quality Assurance and Performance Assessment Plans and reports. 5) Ability to interpret and apply industry and PPV program-wide trends and initiatives to recommend specific actions, strategies and or metrics resulting in measurable and actionable outcomes 6) Ability to review, evaluate and make recommendations related work performed regarding facilities maintenance, construction trades and industry best practices 7) Ability to effectively summarize findings utilizing appropriate resources and programs in brief, narrative, list, table, chart or graph form. NOTE: This experience must be fully and clearly supported in your resume. Details.JobSummary: You will serve as a PUBLIC PRIVATE VENTURE QUALITY SUPPORT ASSURANCE SPECIALIST in the ASSET MANAGEMENT BUSINESS LINE of NAV FACILITIES ENGINEERING COMMAND SE.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will serve as a PPV Quality Assurance Specialist (QAS) and will monitor, analyze and/or evaluate work order performance, including analyzing metrics regarding PPV maintenance and upkeep to determine areas of weakness and overall trends.
You will interpret and apply industry and PPV program-wide trends and initiatives to recommend specific actions, strategies and or metrics resulting in measurable and actionable outcomes.
You will evaluate, analyze, and validate performance indicators for public private venture (PPV) projects, including financial and real property management reporting.
You will monitor performance of technical services performed by the private partners and their vendors.
You will assess compliance with contractual agreements with regard to the upkeep, maintenance and improvement of the physical assets including evaluating long-term sustainment of assets.

You will review current data and trends in work order performance utilizing property management software reports, including engaging with private property managers and government housing representatives, and providing findings to Navy team.

You will build and maintain effective working relationship with all levels of leadership within the NAVFAC organization, Supported Commands and PPV Partners as it relates to effectively executing the QAS job role.
You will assess proposed solutions to maintenance issues, including structural, environmental and mechanical.

You will utilize appropriate resources for effective communication to provide detailed status information regarding financial, development progress, environmental, safety and client coordination issues for management level reporting.
You will use computers and application software; familiarity with MS Office Suite, Yardi, Real Page, One Site or other property management software a plus.
You will conduct on-site evaluations to verify identified data and trends of PPV Property Management.

You will use appropriate resources and programs to prepare reports in brief, narrative, list, table, chart or graph form, as needed to effectively communicate findings and inform management for awareness, action, and/or decision-making.

You will ensure Navy PPV projects improvements and ongoing maintenance performed on physical assets by PPV Partners in accordance with Business Agreements, DoD policy directives, laws, codes, regulations and requirements for PPV projects.

Details.JobSummary: Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) is looking for the best and brightest to join our Team! MCCS is a comprehensive program that supports and enhances the quality of life for Marines, their families, and others in the Marine Corps Community. We offer a team oriented environment comprised of military personnel, civilian employees, contractors and volunteers who keep the organization functioning smoothly and effectively.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Serving Those Who Serve
MajorDuties: Report to MCFTB leadership and aids in the implementation of the Unit, Personal and Family Readiness Program (UPFRP), builds unit and Inspector/Instructor relationships, maintains personal contact, assists, and supports all UPFRP Command Teams as assigned. Serves as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the UPFRP and supports its mission to aid individual Marines in their responsibility to attain and maintain personal and family readiness by providing command outreach and assistance.Proactively works with commanders, units, MARFORRES DRCs, URCs, other appropriate command UPFRP representative, MARFORRES Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) and MARFORRES MCFTB to successfully execute UPFRP training.Plans, coordinates and executes administrative and logistical requirements for UPFRP/Yellow Ribbon Reintegration Program (YRRP) events and trainings such as pre-, mid- and post-deployment training. Delivers briefs and presentations as directed.Assists in developing and implementing UPFRP communication plan of action and conducts proactive outreach, rapport development and multi-faceted communication efforts to assist units in facilitating meaningful two-way communication between the command and its Marines and families.Distributes information and resources from a variety of programs to include: the Psychological Health Outreach Program and the Joint Family Support Assistant Program to all UPFRP Command Teams within the region.Serves as the MCFTB Trainer for the MSC providing HQMC standardized program training curriculum/materials to respective MSC command team members and UPFRP volunteers as needed. Works with leadership to establish training schedules and coordinate delivery of training, providing logistical and administrative support for training sessions. Delivers additional briefs and presentations as necessary.Follows and disseminates Marine Corps Orders, policies, rules and regulations related to and governing the UPFRP. Ensures the assigned units conform to applicable guidance and regulations in the execution of the UPFRP and remains ready to successfully undergo the scrutiny of higher-headquarters assessments.Due to the nature of required work and the vastness of the area of responsibility, the duties may require travel to complete work assignments, and conduct or attend conferences and meetings. May work a fluctuating or otherwise atypical duty schedule to complete required assignments.Assists in the development, implementation, and evaluation of subordinate UPFRPs.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary:
Your resume and supporting documents must show that you meet the qualifications (below) for the grade level or levels for which you are applying. When using education to qualify, the education must have equipped you with the knowledge and ability to perform the work of the position, as evidenced by on-the-job-training in food retail management or an internship or practicum in food retail management. For GS-12: One year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-11 grade level or equivalent to at least GS-11 under other Federal service pay systems, private sector, or military. Specialized experience is demonstrated knowledge of retail procurement and distribution methods; principles, procedures, and techniques of retail food merchandising and retail food store management; and developments in commercial retail food store items, equipment, and practices. Examples of creditable qualifying specialized experience include: (1) Managing a commissary store, supermarket, or similar type of commercial retail food store; (2) Managing a department in a retail food store; (3) Planning, standardizing, or controlling operations in an assigned group of retail food stores; (4) Developing, interpreting, or applying policies, procedures, and operating standards for use in a retail food store; and (5) Providing technical advice on merchandising and operational matters pertaining to grocery, meats, and produce supplies, as well as front-end operations. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. Details.JobSummary: Serves as the Commissary Officer, fully responsible for managing all activities and functions of the commissary. The commissary has the full range of departments; i.e., grocery, meat, produce, management support and other functions.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: With a workforce of more than 13,000 reflecting our nation's diverse cultures and backgrounds, and annual sales of more than $4.5M, the Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) operates a worldwide chain of 236 commissaries providing groceries to active-duty military families, retirees and their families, DeCA employees, and other authorized patrons in a safe and secure shopping environment. A core military family support element and a valued part of military pay and benefits, commissaries contribute to family readiness, enhance the quality of life for America's military and their families, and help recruit and retain the best and brightest men and women to serve our country.
MajorDuties: Position responsibilities include: Managing all activities and functions of a commissary store to include the full range of managerial and supervisory responsibilities. Executing Agency policy, sales, and promotional programs. Coordinating with Zone Manager in developing and implementing local commissary management policies and procedures. Analyzing a variety of management reports to determine efficiency of operations and initiate action to correct deficiencies. Managing and monitoring all budget funding expenditures to ensure that execution is within the parameters of the funding program for their individual store. Directing monitoring, and adjusting the overall execution of the store sales plan, ensuring that sales goals and targets are met. Establishing, monitoring and adjusting an inventory control program and store security program that focuses on the elimination of fraud, waste, and abuse. Establishing, monitoring, and adjusting a variety of programs to include safety, customer relations, sanitation, and patron identification programs. Initiating, approving and obtaining all required concurrences for personnel actions within the store. Promoting DeCA goals and objectives of the EEO and Affirmative Action Program. Participating in customer advisory council meetings. In accordance with the current CCP Manual, applicants are responsible for the completeness and accuracy of their application/resume and must follow the instructions in the vacancy announcement in order to receive consideration. Details.JobSummary: You will serve as a PROGRAM ANALYST in the Surface Training Systems Program Office (PMS 339), Surface Warfare Directorate of NAVSEA HQ FIELD SUPPORT.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will report to the Navigation Systems Assistant Project Manager (APM) and the Navigation/Engineering Systems Principal Assistant Program Manager (PAPM).
You will execute ship acquisition and training program acquisition life cycle duties and responsibilities for navigation equipment/systems.

You will apply a combination of surface ship navigation and training system expertise to develop out year strategic planning for training devices that includes the requirements, curriculum development and delivery to the schoolhouse.
You will adjust out year strategic planning based on new construction and modernization fielding profile changes.

You will determine impacts of training requirements that are not fully funded; communicating training requirements and impacts in a timely manner to allow
for adjustments of unfunded requirements prior to impact.
You will develop and make recommendations for solutions for designing and delivering successful navigation equipment/systems training in consideration of program and resource constraints.

You will draw on surface navigation systems subject matter expertise to provide advice and recommendations to management teams, fleet and other
program stakeholders for defining, planning and executing training system requirements.
You will participate in programs and efforts to coordinate facility and training equipment upgrades and modernization such as TTE installation and overhaul.
You will recommend and defend requirement(s) priority within the Mission Area Chair via the TTE Life Cycle Project Manager.
You will conduct research and analysis to provide recommendations on assigned elements of navigation equipment and system training continuum programs, assessments and proposed investments.
